build_args: FLEET_SHAPE_BLEND=1, then <lagoon42.json from Tools/BoatExport> Lagoon42 <out dir>: reads <out>/Lagoon42_shape.blend
note: Today's Lagoon 42 (the shared fleet template, docs/lagoon42-1): the 'before' every slice of her rebuild is compared against. build_fleet.py builds both hull shells and their decks into Lagoon42_Hull, the two mini-keels into Lagoon42_Board, and the bridge deck, saloon, bimini, crossbeam, nets, helm station, davits, tender and the kit hardware into one object, Lagoon42_Fittings, so 'fittings' holds all of them until slice 2's build names the bridge deck.
joins_note: No joins checked for today's model; slice 1 lists the new hulls' joins (hull to deck flange), slice 2 the bridge deck to the hulls' inner topsides.
